adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces/extends multiple `prisma.credential.findUnique({ where: { id: ... } })` fallbacks that load a credential (including `key`, `userId`, `teamId`, etc.) purely by ID with no ownership scoping. In `packages/core/EventManager.ts` the new DB fetches occur when a destination calendar’s `credentialId` isn’t found in `this.calendarCredentials` (createAllCalendarEvents) and when updating calendar events from booking references, again fetching by `reference.credentialId` only. In `packages/features/bookings/lib/handleCancelBooking.ts` a similar fallback fetches by `credentialId` only if not found in `bookingToDelete.user.credentials`. These code paths would allow using a foreign credential’s OAuth token material if an event destination/reference contains another user/team’s `credentialId`, matching the finding’s IDOR-style risk.
